clauses.text: Bootstrap and Harbor cell ritual use read-only or skip-claim before host attach; attached host mutation-claims under its own resolved host session id.

Forbid raw-UUID last-resort mint mutation-claim on the tree a declared agent host will write; exact later host session id bind only when pre-attach mutation lease is required, with successful release before launch.
Unify CLI occupancy release and Write-hook lease view for the same target worktree; denials and already-free print occupancy file path and hook effectiveRoot when from the Write gate.
Recovery restores ceremony as well as occupancy: name target root, presenter, permitted lease operation, and required rearm or cold ceremony after steal.

For a live minted lease when a declared host-shaped id is already presenting, replace Do-not-steal guidance with a closed runnable steal-or-owner-release then host re-claim path verified through the Write gate.
Validation and pack reporting distinguish occupancy or ritual prevented-entry from independent failures after an admitted first write; keep-outs stand.
